newsitem.title: SPAIN: Spain approves sale of final Repsol stake.
newsitem.headline: Spain approves sale of final Repsol stake.

text.p: Spain said on Friday that it had approved the sale of its final 10 percent stake in blue chip energy group Repsol.
"On April 29 Repsol will be completely privatised," government spokesman Miguel Angel Rodriguez told journalists.
Rodriguez said there would be a domestic and international tranche and an institutional and retail tranche.
He also said that the government expected net income from the sale of some 150 billion pesetas ($1 billion).
"The net income is expected to be some 150 billion pesetas..., a bit more than 150 billion," Rodriguez said.
